observedDecisions: Common text and argv allocation disposes only initialized entries on failure.

Windows quote helper doubles trailing backslashes; UTF8-to-wide conversion preserves empty strings; process spawning duplicates stdio handles and closes temporary handles,thread handles,command buffers.
Windows environment uses case-insensitive matching,last-change wins,sorting,hidden-name parsing and double-NUL termination; owned allocations and borrowed parent block have distinct disposal paths.
POSIX environment preserves borrowed parent entries and frees appended owned entries; spawn file actions and stdio redirects have explicit cleanup on each failure edge.
Wait/poll/drop distinguish owned child lifecycle and platform exit/signal outcomes.
Bounded capture continues draining after truncation/allocation failure, joins both capture workers before reading stream state, and preserves separate stdout/stderr ownership.
